copy.blurb: FIFA World Cup 2026 pits Germany against Curaçao. Our Elo prior, after host and altitude adjustments where they apply, rates Curaçao to win at 21%. Polymarket prices the same outcome at 3% — implying a model-versus-market gap of +17.9 percentage points. That clears our 3pp threshold, so the verdict reads Pick. Calibration history sits with the closing market across recent fixtures; selection is the dimension this Pick is meant to add value on.
